model.initialMorphology: 12 percent of stellar parcels in truncated Plummer bulge; remaining exponential disk with two logarithmic spiral arms, pitch 24 degrees
model.initialVelocities: approximate enclosed-mass circular speeds and random dispersion; not a relaxed equilibrium distribution
model.orbit: prograde; spin and orbital angular momenta have matching negative Y components
model.energyDiagnostic: tree-approximate potential; includes force approximation and integration error
model.generation: every stored frame is a direct sample of the C++ integrator; no prescribed trajectories
model.playback: renderers may interpolate stored positions; interpolation is presentation, not an additional physics solve
model.lightSamples: any extra luminous display samples are not additional simulated mass parcels

morphologyMetrics: r90 and r99 are stellar distances from each parcel's original galaxy core; outside5 is fraction beyond 5 code length units, not an unbound-mass estimate
